import json, subprocess, sys, tempfile, os
SUB="/workspace/submission/main.py"
CFG={"version":1,"idle_timeout":1,"packet_limit":1,"prefix_width":1,"rules":[],"fallback":{"class":1}}
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I",SUB,"compile"],input=json.dumps(CFG).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); path=os.path.join(d,"p.json"); open(path,"w").write(json.dumps(json.loads(p.stdout)))
tests = {
 "deep nest 100000": ("[" * 100000 + "]" * 100000),
 "deep nest obj": ('{"a":' * 50000 + "1" + "}" * 50000),
 "huge int 9000 digits": '{"op":"tick","time":' + "1"*9000 + "}",
 "neg huge int": '{"op":"tick","time":-' + "1"*9000 + "}",
 "float time": '{"op":"tick","time":1e5}',
 "exp time": '{"op":"tick","time":1E5}',
 "leading plus": '{"op":"tick","time":+1}',
 "hex": '{"op":"tick","time":0x10}',
 "single quotes": "{'op':'tick','time':1}",
 "trailing comma": '{"op":"tick","time":1,}',
 "unquoted key": '{op:"tick","time":1}',
 "control char": '{"op":"tick","time":1\x01}',
 "unicode escape ok": '{"op":"tick","time":1}',
}
for name, line in tests.items():
    r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I",SUB,"stream",path],input=(line+"\n").encode(),
                     stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=60)
    print("%-22s rc=%d out=%r" % (name, r.returncode, r.stdout[:60]))
# valid utf-8 multibyte in a string value (unknown key -> error anyway)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I",SUB,"stream",path],input='{"op":"tick","time":1,"\xc3\xa9":1}\n'.encode(),
                 stdout=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=60)
print("%-22s rc=%d out=%r" % ("utf8 extra key", r.returncode, r.stdout[:60]))
EOF
